body:
Aeronautics Plus is a Create-based modpack built around the brand-new Create Aeronautics mod — build and pilot your own airships, planes, hot air balloons, and ground vehicles using the power of physics-simulated contraptions.
🚀 What's in the Pack?
The core experience is Create + Create Aeronautics + Sable, giving you a full physics sandbox for constructing and flying anything you can dream up. Create: Connected adds quality-of-life components like the inverted clutch for cleaner builds, while Create: Enchantment Industry, Create: The Factory Must Grow, and Create: Dragons Plus expand your factory and automation options well beyond the base mod.
SecurityCraft lets you lock down your base or airship hangar, and MrCrayfish's Furniture Mod: Refurbished gives you the tools to make your builds feel lived-in.
On the performance side, the pack runs Sodium, Iris, Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, EntityCulling, ModernFix, and more — so even with Aeronautics' physics pipeline, you stay smooth. Fabric mods are supported via Sinytra Connector.
WorldEdit is included for large-scale building and schematic work.
📋 Requirements

Minecraft 1.21.1
NeoForge
